panel.label: 🏠 Home
panel.name: tab_home
panel.text_editor:
Welcome to the S24 Engine Guide 🚀
This guide provides quick reference for advanced settings, defaults, and tuning tips for experienced users.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 GUIDE SECTIONS
• Common Settings - Full reference for every KVTweaks tab, by tab • S24 Console - Command-line interface to the viewer • Troubleshooting - Common issues and solutions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚡ QUICK START
• Most settings take effect IMMEDIATELY - no restart needed • Shader changes require: RESETS → Purge Shader Cache → Restart • Hover over controls in KVTweaks for detailed tooltips • Use RESETS tab to restore defaults or purge caches
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📂 KVTWEAKS TAB OVERVIEW (19 tabs)
CPU & Memory → Core count, process QoS/scheduling, heap/VRAM budget, threaded avatar motion RAM Cache → KVRAM texture buffer: budget, thresholds, eviction timing Rendering Core → LOD factors, draw distance, avatar feathering, FSR scale/sharpen, shader hardware tier Rendering Adv → SSAO, bump/glow, D3D11 debug layer/shader cache, jelly-doll ghost, volumetric light SSR → Screen-space reflections: global, quality/depth tuning, water-specific override Water → Water appearance: metallic, roughness, tint, motion, horizon fade, presets Sky → Star theme/density/glow, nebula, shooting stars, AND the extra 2.5D cirrus/cumulus cloud decks (one tab, six cards - not two separate tabs) Shadows → Shadow quality, bias/offset, filtering, cascade throttling, spot/tree bias Lighting → Local/spot light limits, HardLight stability mode, light-culling hold time, experimental point-light shadows Textures → Discard level, max resolution, fetch concurrency, HUD limits Network → Bandwidth throttle, ACK timing, plugin threading/CPU/instance limits Audio → Streaming engine choice, VLC 10-band EQ, FMOD 3-band EQ, stream metadata Experimental → GLTF, mirrors/cubemaps, Master Reflection Cube, DXVK, selection beam, menu icons Reflections → Reflection probes: system, sampling, tone, light, limits, Tonemap Everywhere Materials → Reflection gloss/metallic gates, normal/specular map scale, projector specular Alpha → Transparency sort mode, per-face distance, projector light count Resets → Per-tab reset buttons, cache purging, factory reset Movement → Smooth ground/flight movement with acceleration curves and flight thresholds UI Hue → Independent hue rotation per UI category, contrast/shine/grayscale, saved profiles
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 PRO TIP
Start with the Common Settings tab to see the most frequently adjusted values and their defaults. Then explore specific tabs for detailed controls.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES
• These are EXPERT controls - for experienced users • Changes can impact stability and performance • TPV Policy compliant - all settings reset to Linden Lab defaults • Reflections/Water enhancements are opt-in and default to standard values • Ground movement smoothing is disabled by default; flight smoothing is enabled by default

panel.label: ⚙️ Common Settings
panel.name: tab_common_settings
panel.text_editor:
Full reference, organized by the real KVTweaks tabs - verified against the live floater XML, not settings.xml alone. Every default/range below is what the control actually ships with today.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📊 CPU & MEMORY
EmulateCoreCount Default: 0 (auto-detect) Range: 0-128 Override CPU core count detection. 0 = auto, 1-128 = manual override
KVdefault_cores / KVmin_cores / KVmax_cores Default: 8 / 4 / 16 Range: 1-128 (all three) Default/min/max cores allocated for texture decode operations
RenderProcessQoS ("CPU Process QoS" slider) Default: 1 (Normal) Range: 0-2 (0=Eco, 1=Normal, 2=High) Real Windows process/thread scheduling tier, applied at launch. Eco enables EcoQoS power throttling (background-friendly); High disables throttling and boosts main-thread/process priority for best frame timing.
RunMultipleThreads Default: true ("Keep Background Threads Active")
RenderParallelAvatarCharacter ("Threaded Avatar Motion") Default: false Dispatches other avatars' (not self, not animesh) animation/motion blending across worker threads instead of the main thread. No restart needed.
MainWorkTime Default: 1.00 ms Range: 0.01-3.00 ms Main loop time budget per frame
RenderReserveCoresForMainThread (console/settings.xml only - not yet a KVTweaks slider) Default: true Windows CPU Sets: reserves the detected (or overridden) preferred cores for the main/render and window threads, structurally - not via priority elevation.
RenderPreferredCoresOverride (console/settings.xml only - not yet a KVTweaks slider) Default: empty (auto-detect) Manually force which logical processor indices count as "preferred" for the setting above, e.g. "16-31". Needed on dual-CCD AMD X3D chips where auto-detection can't fully confirm which CCD actually has the 3D V-Cache - check Task Manager's per-core view or HWiNFO, then set the real range here.
RenderCPUBasis (console/settings.xml only - not exposed as a KVTweaks slider) Default: 3000 MHz Reference CPU frequency the GPU benchmark biases its classification against
💾 MEMORY (same tab)
MaxHeapSize64 Default: 16 GB Range: 8-64 GB
RenderMaxVRAMBudget Default: 0 (auto-detect) Range: 0-32768 MB
RenderVRAMSoftPressureFraction Default: 0.8 (80%) Range: 0.5-1.0 VRAM usage fraction where the budget allocator starts lowering texture discard levels to stay under budget
RenderMinFreeMainMemoryThreshold Default: 512 MB
NonvisibleObjectsInMemoryTime Default: 64 frames Range: 0-1024 (0=no limit)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 RENDERING CORE
RenderVolumeLODFactor Default: 2.0 Range: 0.0-8.0 - object mesh detail multiplier
RenderAvatarLODFactor Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-4.0
RenderTerrainLODFactor Default: 2.0 Range: 1.0-4.0
RenderTreeLODFactor Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-4.0 - legacy Linden tree detail
RenderFlexTimeFactor Default: 0.0 Range: 0.0-4.0 - flexi-prim time factor
RenderFarClip Default: 128 meters Range: 64-1024 meters
AvatarExtentRefreshPeriodBatch Default: 4 frames Range: 1-32 - spreads avatar extent recompute load
AvatarFeathering Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-8.0 - softens avatar LOD transitions, lower = softer
RenderAutoMuteSurfaceAreaLimit Default: 0 (off) Auto-mute avatars whose attachments exceed this surface area (m²)
RenderCompressTextures Default: true - real-time BC7 GPU texture compression (background, minimal cost)
RenderFlushOrphanedTexturesOnTeleport Default: false Evicts region-change-orphaned textures immediately instead of the slow background cleanup. Off by default - testing linked it to lower framerate.
RenderScalePercent / RenderFSR1Sharpness (FSR upscale) Default: 100% / 0.4 Range: 25-100% / 0.0-1.0 Below 100% scale, FSR EASU upscale engages automatically; sharpening (RCAS) always applies, even at 100%.
RenderHardwareShaderTier Default: -1 (Auto/detected) Range: -1 to 5 Pins a lighting/reflection/SSR cost ceiling instead of following your detected GPU class. Persists until changed or "Reset to recommended settings" in Preferences.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧰 RENDERING ADVANCED
RenderSSAOScale / RenderSSAOMaxScale / RenderSSAOFactor / RenderSSAOEffect Default: 500.0 / 200.0 / 0.3 / 0.7 Ambient occlusion base scale, max scale clamp, intensity, and overall strength
RenderObjectBump Default: true - master bump-mapping/shiny toggle (mirrored on Materials tab)
RenderGlow / RenderGlowResolutionPow Default: true / 9 (2^9) Range (resolution): 8-10
S24DXDebugLayerEnabled ("D3D11 Debug Layer") Default: false - developer-only, real per-draw-call cost, especially on multi-pass work like shadows. Requires restart.
RenderDXShaderCacheEnabled ("DX Shader Cache") Default: true - caches compiled D3D11 shader bytecode to disk instead of recompiling from HLSL every launch. Requires restart.
RenderJellyGhostBaseAlpha / RimIntensity / RimWidth Default: 0.2 / 1.2 / 12.0 - jelly-doll ghost body opacity, edge-glow intensity, and edge-glow width
RenderGodrayIntensity ("Volumetric Light") Default: 0.15 Range: 0.0-3.0 Real raymarched sun light-shaft strength, 0=off
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🪞 SSR (SCREEN-SPACE REFLECTIONS)
RenderScreenSpaceReflections Default: true - master toggle
RenderScreenSpaceReflectionIterations / RayStep / DistanceBias Default: 25 / 0.5 / 0.0 - ray march steps, step size, distance-reject bias
RenderScreenSpaceReflectionGlossySamples / AdaptiveStepMultiplier / GlossThreshold Default: 4 / 1.0 / 0.0 - glossy sample count, adaptive step tuning, and the minimum glossiness before SSR engages (separate from the Materials tab's probe gloss gate, which affects probes, not SSR)
RenderScreenSpaceReflectionDepthRejectBias / RenderSSRMissFill Default: 0.001 / 0.25 - depth-reject bias, and how much probe reflection shows through where SSR misses (0=none, 1=full probe)
RenderWaterSSRIterations / RenderWaterSSRRayStep Default: 15 / 0.15 - water-specific override of the global SSR settings (0 iterations disables water SSR)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖼️ TEXTURES
TextureDiscardLevel Default: 0 (full quality) Range: 0-5
TextureLoadFullRes Default: false - always load highest resolution regardless of other settings
RenderMaxTextureResolution Default: 2048 px Range: 512-4096 px
TextureFetchConcurrency Default: 0 (auto, scales to 16) Range: 0-64 S24 raised the manual cap from 16→64 for modern connections
TextureNewByteRange / TextureReverseByteRange Default: true / 262144 bytes - HTTP byte-range progressive loading, and reverse byte-range size for texture headers (0=disabled)
RenderHUDTexturesWarning / RenderHUDOversizedTexturesWarning / RenderHUDTexturesMemoryWarning Default: 200 / 10 / 256 MB - warning thresholds only, HUD still renders past them
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌊 WATER (KVTweaks → Water - S24 Exclusive System)
Water Preset System Location: KVTweaks → Water tab Features: Save/Load/Delete custom water shader profiles Notes: Complete S24 water control system with named presets
RenderWaterMetallic Default: 1.0 (fully metallic mirror) Range: 0.35-1.0 (below 0.35 causes whiteout) Notes: S24 runtime control - LL hardcodes this at 1.0, now fully adjustable
RenderWaterRoughnessOverride Default: 0.0 (use environment blur) Range: 0.0-0.60 (above 0.60 causes whiteout) Notes: 0.0 = LL behavior, 0.01+ = manual override for custom reflections
RenderWaterReflectionIntensity / RenderWaterSpecularIntensity Default: 1.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-3.0 / 0.0-5.0 Notes: Global reflection strength, and sun/moon specular sparkle intensity
RenderWaterReflectionGateGlossReject / RenderWaterReflectionGateGlossAccept Default: 0.0 / 0.0 (both off) Range: 0.0-1.0 (both) Notes: Water's OWN gloss reflection gate, independent of the Materials tab's shared one - 0 disables it (canonical LL behavior, water has never been gloss-gated upstream). Water's gloss tracks the active preset's Blur Multiplier, not a fixed constant, so a gate tuned for everything else can legitimately clip it.
RenderWaterColorTintR/G/B/A Default: 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 (neutral, no tint) Range: 0.0-2.0 (RGB), 0.0-1.0 (A = tint strength) Notes: A is the master strength - 0.0 disables the tint entirely regardless of RGB
RenderWaterFresnelPower Default: 2.0 Range: 0.5-4.0 Notes: LL hardcodes this at 2.0. Lower=soft linear edge, higher=sharp dramatic edge
RenderWaterWaveSpeed Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-3.0 (0.0 freezes animation) Notes: Wave animation playback speed
RenderWaterShoreFadeDistance Default: 60.0 m Range: 10.0-120.0 m Notes: LL hardcodes this at 60. Lower=softer beach, higher=sharper rocky coast
RenderWaterUnderwaterFogMult Default: 1.0 Range: 0.1-5.0 Notes: Underwater-only visibility multiplier, doesn't affect above-water fog
RenderWaterHorizonFadeIntensity Default: 4.0 Range: 0.0-10.0 Notes: Softens the hard water/sky horizon line with atmospheric haze. 0=off (stock crisp line). Below ~3.0 reads dark, above ~6.0 overexposes. Fades by view angle, so only the far horizon is affected, not water up close.
RenderWaterReflectionWarmth Default: 1.0 Range: 0.5-2.0 Notes: Artistic color grading - below 1.0 cools toward moonlight, above warms toward golden hour
RenderWaterColorAbsorptionRate Default: 0.15 (per meter) Range: 0.01-1.0 Notes: How fast the water tint ramps in with depth (Beer-Lambert style). Lower=clearer shallow water with a long gradient to full tint, higher=tint appears almost immediately at the shore
RenderWaterWindInfluence Default: 0.0 (off) Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Blends live simulator wind (the same system used for sailing - Develop>Wind Vectors to visualize it) into water wave direction and animation speed. 0.0=ignore wind, use only the EEP water preset's authored waves. 1.0=fully follow live wind
RenderWaterWindMagnitudeCap Default: 15.0 Range: 0.0-50.0 Notes: Ceiling on the live wind vector's own strength before it affects water - limits how much a storm/gust can push wave speed/direction regardless of how extreme the simulator's actual wind gets. Only matters when RenderWaterWindInfluence > 0. 0.0=always treat wind as calm
Water Preset System (KVTweaks → Water → Presets card) Notes: Save/Load/Delete named water shader profiles - not individual gSavedSettings keys, a combo + Save/Delete button pair
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌌 SKY (KVTweaks → Sky - stars, nebula, meteors AND the 2.5D cloud decks, one tab)
RenderSkyStyle Default: 0 (Default) Options: 0=Default, 1=Real Constellations, 2=Starry Night (Van Gogh) Notes: Requires a viewer restart - star placement is baked once at startup
RenderConstellationLines Default: false Notes: Thin dotted lines connecting each constellation's stars into its real shape
RenderStarGlow Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-3.0 Notes: 0-1 scales brightness; above 1.0 adds a soft colored haze halo instead of blowing out to white
RenderStarDensity Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Fraction of the star field shown - pure visibility cull, no performance cost
RenderStarDustIntensity / RenderNebulaIntensity Default: 1.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-2.0 (both) Notes: Milky-Way-style dust band, and soft colored nebula patch strength
RenderNebulaEnabled Default: true - master toggle for nebula patches, separate from their intensity slider
RenderShootingStars / RenderShootingStarFrequency Default: true / 4.0 per minute Range (frequency): 0.0-20.0 Notes: 0=effectively off, 20=meteor shower
RenderCloudLayers Default: true Notes: Extra cirrus/cumulus decks layered on top of the active preset's own clouds - complementary, not a replacement
RenderCloudLayerOpacity Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-2.0 Notes: Opacity multiplier for the extra decks
RenderCloudLayerHeightSkew Default: 0.3 Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Visual skew trick to make cirrus read higher / cumulus read lower than the base layer - not true altitude
RenderCloudCirrusScale / RenderCloudCumulusScale Default: 0.55 / 1.7 Notes: Cell-size ratios relative to the active preset's own cloud scale
RenderCloudCirrusScrollMult / RenderCloudCumulusScrollMult Default: 1.6 / 0.6 Notes: Wind-scroll speed multipliers relative to the base cloud layer's own rate
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 RAM CACHE (KVTweaks → RAM Cache)
KVRAMCacheEnabled Default: Disabled (false) Notes: Fast RAM buffer for GPU-evicted textures. Reduces disk I/O when textures are re-requested. Passive equilibrium system with user-controlled budget.
KVRAMCacheRAMBudgetMB Default: 2048 MB Range: 256-4096 MB (in 256 MB steps) Notes: RAM cache size for texture buffer. Higher values = more texture cache hits before disk fetch. Monitor system RAM usage when increasing.
KVRAMCacheSoftThreshold Default: 0.75 (75%) Range: 0.5-1.0 Notes: Begin gentle RAM-to-Disk eviction at this buffer usage level. Passive cleanup.
KVRAMCacheHardThreshold Default: 0.90 (90%) Range: 0.7-1.0 Notes: Aggressive RAM-to-Disk eviction at this usage (emergency mode). Prevents overflow.
KVRAMCacheRetentionTimeSec (renamed from KVRAMCacheGracePeriodSec) Default: 10.0 seconds Range: 0.1-30.0 seconds (0.1 second steps) Notes: Minimum retention time before a texture is eligible for eviction. Lower = more aggressive cleanup, higher = less churn.
KVRAMCacheMinDeckSize Default: 100 textures Range: 100-10000 textures (100 steps) Notes: Minimum texture deck size. Higher = more cache hits before rotation/eviction.
KVRAMCacheDebugLogging Default: Disabled (false) Notes: Enable verbose logging (evictions, queries, pressure). Use for diagnostics.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌑 SHADOWS (KVTweaks → Shadows)
RenderShadowResolutionScale Default: 1.0 Range: 0.25-4.0
RenderShadowBias / RenderShadowOffset Default: 0.0 / 0.0 Range: -0.5 to 0.5 (both) Notes: Main directional-light shadow depth bias/offset - reduces acne (too low) or peter-panning (too high)
RenderShadowNoise / RenderShadowBlurSize / RenderShadowBlurDistFactor Default: 0.0 / 1.4 / 4.0 Notes: Shadow-edge noise magnitude, blur kernel scale, and blur distance falloff
RenderShadowThrottleEnabled / RenderShadowThrottleSettleFrames Default: true / 6 frames Notes: Distant cascades update less often while the camera is still, for free performance with no visible quality loss. Settle frames = how long to wait after the camera stops before throttling kicks in.
RenderShadowBiasError / RenderShadowOffsetError Default: 0.0 / 0.0 Range: -1.0 to 1.0 (both) Notes: Altitude-based bias/offset correction
RenderSpotShadowBias / RenderSpotShadowOffset Default: 0.0 / 0.04
RenderDeferredTreeShadowBias / RenderDeferredTreeShadowOffset Default: 1.0 / 1.0
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 LIGHTING (KVTweaks → Lighting - LOCAL/spot lights, not sun/moon - sun/moon live in Environment/EEP editor, not here)
RenderLocalLightCount Default: 256 Range: 0-8192 (0=unlimited)
RenderAttachedLights / RenderSpotLightsInNondeferred Default: true / true
RenderLocalLightFrustumCulling ("HardLight Mode") Default: false Notes: Excludes off-screen local lights from competing for rendering priority - dramatically improves lighting stability in complex scenes. Lights near your own avatar are always exempt, so a cammed-out shot doesn't extinguish your own surroundings. Off = traditional LL behavior (distant off-screen lights can steal priority).
RenderDeferredSpotShadowBias / RenderDeferredSpotShadowOffset Default: 0.0 / 0.0
RenderLocalLightHoldTime Default: 0.30 sec Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Minimum time a local light holds its last visibility state before flipping - smooths flicker from marginal frustum-edge cases. Only does real work when Frustum Culling is enabled. 0=instant/hard cutoff.
RenderLocalLightFrustumMargin Default: 32.0 m Range: 0.0-64.0 Notes: Extra world-space slack added to a light's frustum visibility test
RenderLocalLightMinRadius Default: 15.0 m Range: 0.0-64.0 Notes: Extends how far a local light's glow reaches to at least this many meters via a soft tail, without changing its true brightness up close - fixes small decorative lights needing the camera almost inside them to light anything. 0 = no extended reach.
RenderLocalLightReachGlow Default: 0.35 Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Peak strength of the reach-extension glow above, as a fraction of a light's own center brightness. 0 = extended reach is invisible (same look as RenderLocalLightMinRadius=0).
RenderPointLightShadows ("K-Light", Experimental) Default: false Notes: Real-time shadow casting for ordinary point/omni lights via a 6-face cubemap capture. Significant GPU cost while active, face-boundary seams are a known limitation.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ REFLECTIONS (KVTweaks → Reflections)
RenderReflectionProbesEnabled Default: true - master toggle, requires a shader rebuild (RESETS → Purge Shader Cache → Restart) to take effect
RenderReflectionProbeLevel / Detail / Count / Resolution Default: 3 (Everything) / -1 (Once) / 128 / 128 px Notes: Content captured (sky+clouds / +terrain / +water / everything), update mode (Once/Static/Static+dynamic/Realtime), how many cube slots held at once (16-256), and resolution per cube face (64-512 px)
RenderReflectionAutoParallax / RenderReflectionBoxProbesEnabled Default: true / true
RenderReflectionExcludeAvatarDynamic / RenderReflectionExcludeAvatarRealtime Default: false / true Notes: Performance choices - keep avatars/particles out of the master reflection cube under Static+dynamic / Realtime detail
Reflection Intensity / Saturation / Contrast Default: 1.0 / 1.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-10.0 / 0.0-5.0 / 0.0-5.0
RenderTonemapEverywhere ("Tonemap Everywhere!") Default: false Notes: Legacy skies (Linden/stock sky and water, or anything predating HDR probe support) normally force tonemap and exposure off with no user edit path - Linden's own sky is a no-modify asset. This gives legacy skies a tiny, unsaved reflection-probe-ambiance value just large enough to unlock tonemap/exposure, without visibly changing ambient lighting the way "Auto-Adjust Legacy Skies" (Advanced Graphics) would.
Reflection Blur (RenderReflectionProbeBlurSpread) Default: 0.0 (sharp, no cost) Range: 0.0-0.1 Notes: Direction-space smudge, independent of probe mip resolution. Real per-pixel 16-tap cost even at small values - past ~0.06-0.08 the kernel's sample gaps separate into ghosts again.
Ambient Contribution (RenderReflectionProbeAmbientMultiplier) Default: 1.0 Range: 0.0-10.0
Equalize Faces / Opacity Default: 0.0 / 1.0 Range: 0.0-1.0 (both)
RenderReflectionProbeMaxLocalLightAmbiance Default: 4.0 Range: 0.0-16.0 Notes: Caps local light level while probes are captured - lower reduces light bleed into reflections
RenderReflectionProbeDrawDistance Default: 64 m Range: 16-512 Notes: How far each capture reaches - NOT the view draw distance
RenderDefaultProbeUpdatePeriod / RenderDefaultProbeFadeWeight Default: 2.0 sec / 0.35 Notes: Seconds between sky/default probe refreshes (also drives ambient light), and how much of each refresh applies at once (1.0=snap instantly, lower smooths the pop as sky/clouds change)
RenderHeroProbeDistance ("Mirror Probe Distance") Default: 8 m Range: 0-1024
RenderSSAOIrradianceScale / RenderSSAOIrradianceMax Default: 0.6 / 0.18 Notes: Strength and clamp of ambient occlusion applied to probe irradiance
RenderReflectionProbeCaptureShadows Default: true Notes: Computes real sun shadows inside reflection/mirror/360 captures. Off skips that per-face cost during probe-heavy moments (e.g. right after login) at the cost of shadow detail in reflections only.
⚠ If any of these tweaks appear to do nothing: RESETS → Purge Shader Cache → Restart. Note: "Reset Cubemap Defaults" on this tab does NOT reset Tonemap Everywhere or Capture Shadows - those two persist through that specific reset button.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧪 MATERIALS (KVTweaks → Materials)
RenderReflectionGateGlossReject / RenderReflectionGateGlossAccept Default: 0.65 / 0.65 (both) Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Gloss (=1-roughness) at or below Reject gets no probe reflection; at or above Accept gets full reflection; ramped between. Probes only - SSR has its own separate threshold on the SSR tab. Equal defaults approximate the original LL hardcoded hard-cutoff behavior.
RenderReflectionGateMetallicReject / RenderReflectionGateMetallicAccept Default: 0.65 / 0.65 (both) Range: 0.0-1.0 Notes: Same gate shape, for the PBR-only metallic channel. Legacy materials have no metallic channel and are unaffected.
RenderNormalMapScale Default: 64.0 Range: 1.0-256.0 Notes: Height-map scale used when generating normal maps from bump textures
RenderSpecularExponent Default: 368 Range: 1-1000 Notes: Specular exponent for the legacy (non-PBR) specular map
RenderProjectorSpecularReliable Default: false Notes: Projector lights only - widens the specular highlight and keeps its color with distance. Enables the two settings below.
RenderProjectorSpecularExponent / RenderProjectorSpecularLODCap Default: 24 / 1.0 Notes: Only used while the checkbox above is on - lower exponent=wider highlight, lower LOD cap=sharper color at distance
RenderProjectorPBRLegacySpecular Default: false - PBR surfaces under projector lights use the legacy specular lobe instead of GGX when enabled
RenderObjectBump Default: true - same control as Rendering Adv's Bump/Shiny toggle
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔺 ALPHA (KVTweaks → Alpha)
RenderAlphaSortMode Default: 1 (per-face, sorted by distance) Range: 0-1 Notes: 0=batch order (faces draw in build order), 1=per face (sorted by distance, farthest first). Near-opaque faces write depth in both modes.
RenderAlphaFaceSortDistance / RenderAlphaSortExtentFactor / RenderAlphaDepthWriteThreshold Default: 24 m / 0.5 / 0.98 Notes: Per-face sort distance, depth extent factor, and the alpha threshold above which a face writes depth (1.01=off)
RenderAlphaProjectorCount / RenderAlphaProjectors Default: 2 / false Notes: Max alpha-affecting projector lights, and whether projected lights light transparent surfaces at all (fading with their alpha)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 UI HUE (KVTweaks → UI Hue)
RenderUIGrayscale / RenderUIContrast / RenderUIShine Default: false / 1.0 / 0.0 Notes: Desaturate the whole system independent of hue; contrast (<1.0 flatter, >1.0 punchier); a fixed diagonal glass-sheen overlay (0=off)
RenderUIHueShiftFloaters / Menus / Controls / Text / Inventory / Map / Script / Misc Default: 0.0 (degrees) each Range: -180.0 to 180.0 Notes: Rotates each UI color category's hue independently. Floaters=window chrome/panels/notification toasts, Menus=menu bar/pie menu, Controls= buttons/icons/sliders/scrollbars, Text=chat/nametags/tooltips, Inventory=inventory/folders/outfits, Map=minimap/beacons/pathfinding, Script=script editor, Misc=login screen/everything else. 0=skin default; pure white/gray/black is unaffected (no hue at zero saturation)
Color Profiles (Save/Delete buttons + combo) Notes: Save the current hue sliders as a named profile, or load/delete a saved one - not individual gSavedSettings keys. Changes apply live, no separate "apply" step needed.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎮 MOVEMENT (KVTweaks → Movement)
SmoothKeyboardMovement (ground walking/running) Default: Disabled (false) - purely aesthetic enhancement
SmoothMovementAccelTime / SmoothMovementDecelTime Default: 0.20s / 0.25s Range: 0.05-1.0s (both)
SmoothFlightMovement (flying) Default: Enabled (true) - separate system from ground smoothing, on by default unlike it
SmoothFlightAccelTime / SmoothFlightDecelTime Default: 0.15s / 0.20s Range: 0.05-1.0s (both)
SmoothFlightFastThreshold / SmoothFlightMinThreshold Default: 0.70 / 0.15 Range: 0.50-0.95 / 0.0-0.50 Notes: Fast-movement trigger threshold (lower=more responsive), and the dead zone before any movement starts (higher=more damping of initial boost)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌐 NETWORK (KVTweaks → Network)
ThrottleBandwidthKBPS Default: 3000 kbps Range: 500-50000 kbps Notes: S24 raised the cap from 10 Mbps to 50 Mbps for modern connections. Recommend 20000-40000 for fast fiber
AckCollectTime Default: 0.1 sec Range: 0.001-1.0 sec
PluginUseReadThread Default: false - offload plugin (media/CEF) I/O to a dedicated thread
PluginInstancesCPULimit Default: 0.90 (90%) Range: 0.0-0.99 (0=disabled)
PluginInstancesUIMax Default: 8 Range: 2-64 Notes: Caps concurrent CEF/Dullahan instances used by viewer UI (profiles, search, marketplace, web/help browser, popout windows) - previously unbounded. The longest-idle hidden instance unloads first when over this limit; anything visible/focused is never evicted.
PluginDisableGPU Default: true Notes: Skips CEF's GPU process for every web-UI instance, dropping one subprocess per instance - viewer web UI doesn't need hardware compositing. Applies to newly-created instances.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔊 AUDIO (KVTweaks → Audio)
StreamingAudioEngine Default: 0 (Media Plugins/libVLC) Options: 0=libVLC (better codecs, 10-band EQ, metadata), 1=FMOD (3-band EQ, metadata)
ShowStreamMetadata Default: true - shows streaming song title/artist as a notification
AudioEqualizerEnabled (FMOD engine, 3-band) Default: false AudioEqualizerLowGain / MidGain / HighGain Default: 0.0 / 0.0 / 0.0 Range: -30dB to +10dB (0=flat)
VLCAudioEQEnabled (libVLC engine, 10-band) Default: false VLCAudioEQBand0-9 (60Hz/170Hz/310Hz/600Hz/1k/3k/6k/12k/14k/16k) Default: 0.0 dB each Range: -20dB to +20dB VLCAudioEQPreamp Default: 0.0 dB Range: -20dB to +20dB VLCAudioEQPreset Default: 0 (Flat/Manual) Options: Flat, Rock, Pop, Jazz, Classical, Dance, Bass Boost, Vocal Boost, Treble Boost, Full Bass & Treble
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔬 EXPERIMENTAL (KVTweaks → Experimental)
GLTFEnabled Default: false ⚠ Can trigger implicit texture uploads costing L$. Persists across restarts.
RenderMirrors Default: false - planar mirrors (experimental)
RenderCubeMap Default: true - master toggle for cube-map-based reflections (water, bump/shiny, sky). Requires restart.
RenderReflectionMasterCube / RenderReflectionMasterCubeRadius Default: true / 20 m Notes: Every glossy/shiny/mirror surface samples one avatar-centred capture instead of per-location probe selection - recommended default, fast enough under Dynamic/Realtime to stay locally relevant as you move. Not room-fitted, so very close reflections can look scaled/zoomed. Radius takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
UseMenuIcons Default: true - emoji icons in the menu bar, requires restart
HoverTextDistance / HoverTextFadeDistance Default: 3.0 m / 1.5 m Requires restart
RenderUseDXVK ("DXVK (Vulkan Backend)") Default: false ⚠ EXPERIMENTAL: routes D3D11 through DXVK's Vulkan translation layer instead of the native driver. DX context popout windows are incompatible in Vulkan mode. Requires restart.
SelectionBeamStyle Default: 2 (Hybrid - Line + Glow, "Lightsaber") Options: 0=Particles Only (Classic), 1=Solid Line Only, 2=Hybrid Line+Glow
SelectionBeamLineStyle Default: 0 (Solid) Options: 0=Solid, 1=Dotted, 2=Dashed, 3=Dash-Dot
SelectionBeamWidth Default: 2.0 pixels Range: 0.5-6.0 Notes: Real DX11 billboard geometry - D3D11 has no glLineWidth() equivalent
SelectionBeamParticleScale Default: 1.5 Range: 0.5-3.0 Notes: Glow particle size for the Hybrid style
Beam Color Location: Preferences → Colors → My Effects Notes: Not a KVTweaks control - separate color picker panel
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧹 RESETS (KVTweaks → Resets)
Reset KVTweaks to Defaults Notes: Resets EVERY control across the entire KVTweaks floater (all 19 tabs), immediate effect, no restart needed, no confirmation dialog
Purge Texture Cache / Purge CEF Cache / Purge RAM Cache Notes: Texture and CEF purges need a restart to complete; RAM cache purge is immediate (calls KVRAMCache::clearAll() directly)
Purge Shader Cache Notes: Deletes compiled shaders now; they rebuild on next launch - RESTART REQUIRED
Purge Logs Notes: Sets a flag; actual deletion happens on next startup (log files are locked while running), not truly immediate despite the button's tooltip
⚠ FACTORY RESET EVERYTHING Notes: Opens a confirmation floater, then on confirm schedules a full cache+settings wipe and force-quits - the actual wipe runs at final shutdown via an external helper, requiring a full relaunch. Last resort only.
Per-tab reset buttons (Cubemap/Materials/Movement/UI Hue/Alpha) Notes: Each only resets its OWN tab's controls, unlike the floater-wide button above - see each section's notes for exact exceptions (e.g. Cubemap's reset does not touch Tonemap Everywhere)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 PRO TIP
These settings are from the actual, live KVTweaks tabs - verified against the real floater XML, not just settings.xml. Many are dynamically managed by the viewer (VRAM, texture memory, thread counts). Start with defaults and adjust incrementally while monitoring FPS and system resources.

panel.label: 💻 S24 Console
panel.name: tab_console
panel.text_editor:
Command-line interface to the viewer. Access with Ctrl+Shift+4
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔍 OBJECT & AVATAR COMMANDS
find <name|uuid> Select and beacon a specific avatar (or object, by UUID) - great for locating something transparent or hard to see Example: find john
find clear Remove the active beacon (also: find off)
top [mode] [options] Top objects by cost/physics/streaming/triangles/scripts (UNIX-style tool) Modes: cost/render, physics/phys, streaming, triangles/tris, script/scripts Scope: -p/--parcel, -r/--region Ownership: -s/--self, -g/--group, -o/--owner UUID Display: -n/--limit N (default 10, max 50) Example: top scripts -p -s Full syntax: top --help
lookat <name|uuid> Point camera at avatar or object (partial name matching) Example: lookat john
scan [range] Show all avatars in sim with distance and UUID (optional range in meters, default unlimited) Example: scan 50
whois <name|uuid> Show detailed avatar information (UUID, display name, profile) Example: whois john
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ SETTINGS MANAGEMENT
get <setting> Read current value of a debug setting Supports wildcard: get *texture* Example: get RenderFarClip
set <setting> <value> Change a debug setting value (auto-detects BOOL/S32/U32/F32/STRING) Example: set RenderFarClip 256
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌐 WEB & INFORMATION
motd Display Message of the Day with URL
web <url> Open URL in preferred browser (internal/external) Example: web https://secondlife.com
ver Show S24 version and build information
time Display current SL time and local time
uptime Show viewer session uptime
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🪟 FLOATER MANAGEMENT
open list Show all registered floater names in the viewer
open <name> Open a specific floater window Example: open preferences
open close <name> Close a specific floater window Example: open close inventory
open toggle <name> Toggle a floater's visibility Example: open toggle preferences
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✈️ MOVEMENT & POSITIONING
tp <home|back|cam|name|uuid> Teleport to home, your previous location, your camera position, or a named/UUID avatar - use lookat/scan first to identify a target Example: tp home
fly Toggle flight mode on/off
fly <altitude> Fly to absolute altitude (smooth autopilot movement) Example: fly 1000
fly <altitude> --fast Fly to altitude with turbo boost Example: fly 1000 --fast
fly down Descend to ground level (0.5m hover)
fly down --fast Fast descent to ground
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💬 CHAT & COMMUNICATION
say <message> Send message to local chat Example: say Hello World
shout <message> Send message with extended range (shout) Example: shout Can anyone hear me?
echo <text> Echo text back to console (testing/debugging) Example: echo test message
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠️ UTILITY COMMANDS
calc <expression> Evaluate mathematical expression Example: calc 2 + 2 * 3
uuid <uuid> Identify what a UUID represents (avatar, object, texture, inventory, group, or your own agent/session ID) Example: uuid 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
clear (alias: cls) Clear the console output buffer
quit (alias: exit) Close the S24 Console window
shutdown now Quit the viewer immediately (clean shutdown - skips the confirmation dialog, logout/metrics still run normally)
shutdown <seconds> Quit the viewer after a countdown Example: shutdown 300 (exit in 5 minutes)
shutdown cancel Abort a scheduled shutdown timer (aliases: abort, stop)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📖 HELP SYSTEM
list Display the full command list with syntax (this reference, in-console)
help <command> Show quick help for specific command Example: help top
<command> --help Show detailed documentation with examples (where available, e.g. top) Example: top --help
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 TIPS & BEST PRACTICES
• Commands are case-insensitive: GET, get, Get all work • Use ↑/↓ arrow keys to recall command history • Partial name matching: lookat foo finds "Foo Resident" • Unlimited range: scan and find work beyond draw distance • Beacon persistence: Beacons track moving avatars automatically • Wildcard search: Use * in get commands to find related settings
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔒 PRIVACY & SAFETY
• Help examples use privacy-safe placeholders (not real UUIDs) • TPV Policy compliant - respects LL's viewer boundaries • No remote execution - all commands are local to your viewer • No automated scanning - all actions require explicit commands

panel.label: 🔧 Troubleshooting
panel.name: tab_troubleshooting
panel.text_editor:
Common issues and solutions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖥️ LOW FPS / STUTTERING
Symptom: Viewer runs slowly or has periodic frame drops
Solutions: • Reduce RenderFarClip (draw distance) to 64-128m • Lower RenderVolumeLODFactor to 1.5 or 1.0 • Disable Advanced Lighting in Preferences if GPU-limited • Check shadow resolution scale - lower if needed • Use Performance Test Mode to isolate GPU vs CPU bottlenecks • Monitor texture memory - reduce if exceeding VRAM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 WATER LOOKS WRONG
Symptom: Water appears too bright, too dark, or wrong color
Solutions: • Verify environment has proper water settings loaded • Disable Custom Tint if enabled in Water tab • Check Reflections: Reflection Probes must be enabled (Preferences → Graphics → Advanced) • Purge Shaders: Water shader changes may require cache purge + restart • Reset Water Metallic to 1.0 and Roughness Override to 0.0
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌑 SHADOW ACNE / LIGHT LEAKS
Symptom: Surfaces show speckled patterns or light bleeding through
Solutions: • Adjust Shadow Bias settings in Shadows tab • Check Resolution Scale - default is 1.0 • Increase Normal Offset slightly if acne persists • Try different shadow quality presets • Update GPU drivers - shadow artifacts often driver-related
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌳 MISSING TREES / GRASS
Symptom: Legacy Linden trees and grass not visible
Solutions: • Check render types: Advanced → Rendering → Types • Verify TREE and GRASS render types are enabled • Disable Performance Test Mode if active • Ensure pool skip isn't hiding vegetation (should be protected) • Region must support legacy vegetation objects
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🏃 SMOOTH MOVEMENT FEELS WRONG
Symptom: Movement feels sluggish or unresponsive after enabling
Solutions: • Reduce Acceleration Time from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds • Reduce Deceleration Time from 0.15 to 0.05 seconds • Disable feature if unnecessary - purely aesthetic • Feature is in Movement tab of KVTweaks
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💾 SETTINGS DON'T PERSIST
Symptom: KVTweaks settings reset after viewer restart
Solutions: • Ensure settings.xml is not read-only • Exit viewer properly (use Quit, not force-close) • Check file permissions in AppData folder • Most settings save immediately when changed
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💥 CRASHES AFTER CHANGES
Symptom: Viewer crashes or becomes unstable
Recovery Steps: 1. Start viewer with -noprobe flag (disables reflection probes) 2. Open KVTweaks → RESETS tab 3. Click Factory Reset 4. Click Purge All Caches 5. Restart normally 6. Re-enable settings gradually to isolate problem
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
☢️ NUCLEAR OPTION: COMPLETE RESET
When all else fails - return to absolute default state:
1. RESETS → Factory Reset (restores KVTweaks defaults) 2. RESETS → Purge All Caches (clears shader, texture, etc.) 3. Preferences → Graphics → Reset to Defaults 4. Restart viewer 5. Verify standard LL settings work before re-tweaking

📝 STILL HAVING ISSUES?
Document before seeking help: • Screenshot each KVTweaks tab showing your settings • Note GPU model, RAM, driver version • Try updating GPU drivers first (most common fix) • Check viewer log for errors (Help → Report Bug → View Log)
Most rendering issues are GPU driver related!
